title: Manual Test Engineer
summary: A manual test engineer checks software by hand to find bugs before users do. They sit in the QA (quality assurance) team inside a Scrum team, turning requirements into test cases and tracking defects until they are fixed.
dailyDuties: Turn requirements into test scenarios and test cases
Run functional, regression, smoke and sanity tests by hand
Log clear defects with steps in Jira and track them to closure
Check data in the database with SQL
Support business users through acceptance testing
Report test status to developers and leads

skills.expectation: Write and run functional, regression, smoke and sanity tests by hand
Follow the testing life cycle and turn requirements into test scenarios
Log clear defects with steps and track them to closure in Jira or similar
Write SQL to check data in the database
Report test status and defects clearly to developers and leads
Support business users through acceptance testing
Test banking, payments or lending flows
Find the cause behind odd behaviour
